title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders Payment Operations — Payments on a Case That Has Changed Orthodontist
content:
**Orthodontic Benefit Riders (Cascade Ortho Rider family): paying a case after a change of orthodontist.**

## The rule

When the patient changes orthodontist during active treatment, the case continues under the same case number and the unpaid part of the case benefit is re-spread over the payments still to come at the new practice. Within that:

- This rule fixes the first payment Cascade issues on the case after it has moved.
- Each later payment of a moved case is the same share of the carried benefit as the first payment covers for one service period.
- Every payment of a moved case goes to the new practice when it is in network, and to the member otherwise.
- Every installment of a case that has not moved remains under the installment rules of the rider.

Scope:

- This rule applies only to a person whose current rider is the only Cascade orthodontic rider the person has held.
- For any other person, the unpaid part of the case benefit (the case benefit less the payments made on the case) is re-spread over the installments still due, paid to the new practice when it is in network and to the member otherwise.

## Issue dates and held installments

Each installment is issued on the rider's installment due day of the first month of its service period, following the schedule set at establishment as revised by a transfer, except that once a paid dental claim line shows the patient at an orthodontist whose participation agreement is not the one named on the case's latest establishment or transfer entry, the installments whose service periods begin after that line was adjudicated are held and are paid only through the first carried payment once the case's transfer to that orthodontist is recorded.

The first carried payment is fixed only after the case's records carry a transfer entry dated on or after the patient's first visit at the orthodontist now treating the patient.

In other words, while the case's records hold no transfer entry dated on or after that first visit, the first carried payment is not yet fixed.

## What the first carried payment carries

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Installment position | the position that follows the installments issued and not reversed on the case |
| Service period | the one that starts one service period (one month, or three months on a quarterly schedule) after the service period of the latest installment issued on the case |
| Payee | the member when the latest transfer entry is out of network; the practice named on that entry when it is in network |

## Issuing the payment: `issue_ortho_carried_payment_56eb10f4`

The agent unlocks the agent tool `issue_ortho_carried_payment_56eb10f4` and then calls it. One call books a single installment payment on the case for the stated service period and payee, dated today, and adds the amount to the orthodontic benefit paid under the patient's rider. Nothing else on the case changes.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ortho_case_event_id` | reference number of the establishment entry of the orthodontic case, as returned by the orthodontic case lookup for the patient's rider | identifier |
| `installment_number` | position of this payment in the case payment schedule | whole number; 0 for the initial payment, 1 upward for installments |
| `service_period` | the month the payment covers, or the starting month of the quarter it covers | YYYY-MM |
| `payee` | who receives the payment | `practice` (the orthodontist now treating the patient is paid under an assignment of benefits as a participating practice) or `member` (that orthodontist is not participating and the subscriber is paid) |
| `provider_agreement_id` | reference number of the participation agreement of the practice that receives the payment, as returned by the provider agreement lookup | identifier; empty string when the member is paid |
| `amount` | the payment amount | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive, rounded half up to the cent; booked as given |

**Receipt.** A successful call returns:

- the payment reference (`payment`);
- the case number;
- the installment number;
- the service period;
- the payee;
- the amount;
- the payment date;
- the orthodontic benefit paid under the rider, including this payment.

A receipt carrying a payment reference means the payment was issued.
